postData.caption:
Hello Peerlist. 


Happening any minute! Our CEO at DeepSky Chris Chang is hosting an AMA with a post on Peerlist.


https://peerlist.io/chrchang


⏰ Time: 10:15am PDT, Tuesday July 29 /

which is 10:45 PM IST on Tuesday, July 29 in India.


He'll start a post shortly and you can comment and ask me anything you want to know.


He'll discuss all things AI, Agents, building, founding etc.


Hi Background: Founder and CEO at deepsky.ai based in SF Bay Area


Previously AI at Netflix and Pinterest.


Looking forward to having you join.
